binding_applicability_and_unproven_items: All four bindings are rpa.execution.build-binding.v1, static Release, Windows x64 MSVC 19.51.36256.0; allocation lifetime/execution observers are ON, other listed instrumentation is OFF. They identify their own source/tree/binary and registered revision-3 workload only.

None of the four binding source SHAs equals checked-out ce2a9a6952fd4a9a4d82949544f7ef3482e204e6. The shared capacity-probe hash in high-3 and f5f9191 does not establish whole-product equivalence or current-candidate validity.

No top-level semantic-graph binding field exists in these v1 artifacts. A source-content file hash map does not establish complete semantic-graph coverage. The current instruction says that graph is unimplemented, so memory/P8 formal claim stays blocked.

These packets do not cover revision 4, 40000 content rows, GPU/driver/direct malloc/OS heaps, process private commit or working set, prepare-only peaks, observer perturbation, repeatability, cross-machine behavior, or 40000 entities at 240 FPS.

The report-mentioned original 40000-row encoder failure has no separately identified raw packet within these audited case directories; its identity, count and disposition are not added to the five-packet count.
Recorded durations are historical fields, not new timing measurements or performance evidence. No pass/acceptance is re-adjudicated here.
